title: mymind feature tabs
description: A pale panel with a soft shadow: four tab names over thin hairlines, the active one inked while a tangerine line fills across it over a few seconds before moving to the next tab; each tab shows a large grotesk title and slate paragraph at the bottom left and a tall picture on the right, crossfading between tabs. On phones only the lines show, with the picture between title and text.
notes: needs JavaScript to switch tabs; without it the first tab shows
with reduced motion the tabs don't advance on their own
